how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-searing-gorge-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4449:details:2: Teach them geologists a lesson! Oh... an' can ya get me some pieces of ⟦E4⟧ cloth for... for... nothin'.
rows.quest:4449:progress:0: I ain't got all day! Get me those pieces of ⟦E4⟧ cloth! I mean geologists. Get those geologists! They deserve to feel my, well... your wrath.

rows.quest:4450:details:0: Oh, you know what? That reminds me.

rows.quest:3181:details:1: Upon further examination, you notice that the metal is actually a broken axe head. On the metal, the following words are etched:
rows.quest:3181:details:3: When you try and dislodge the broken axe head, it shatters into a million pieces.
rows.quest:3181:progress:0: No, I will not open the gate.
rows.quest:3181:completion:0: What have you got there? A fake obviously!

rows.quest:3367:details:1: I'm badly injured, ⟦82⟧. Feel... light headed... World spinning... ⟦E19⟧... internally.
rows.quest:3367:details:2: I must get back to ⟦E18⟧. Help me, ⟦83⟧.⟦84⟧
rows.quest:3367:progress:0: I'm not going to make it...

rows.quest:3368:obj:0: Take the ⟦E20⟧ to Thorius in ⟦E18⟧. He is in the Hall of Explorers.
rows.quest:3368:details:1: If you are reading this letter, I am no more. How it got to you, I do not know, but thank and reward the ones responsible.
rows.quest:3368:details:2: About the stones: They exist and the Dark Irons have them in their possession. Their leader, ⟦E21⟧, is using the power of the stones to enslave my excavation team. They were taken to the cauldron. Their minds are twisted, working night and day to complete something called Obsidion.
rows.quest:3368:details:3: Help them, brother. It is the final wish of a dead man.
rows.quest:3368:completion:1: In the name of the Light, he will have his wish. This I vow.
rows.quest:3441:completion:0: Have you heard enough? Are you prepared to act?
rows.quest:3442:obj:0: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of ⟦E23⟧ and return the items to ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:3442:details:0: You have made the right decision, ⟦87⟧.
rows.quest:3442:details:1: We must strike where we will do the most damage: the four sentry towers.
rows.quest:3442:details:2: With the four towers in flames, we can initiate an offensive before they have time to react.
rows.quest:3442:details:3: You will need the proper tool to set the towers ablaze. To make the tool requires some materials.
rows.quest:3442:details:4: Bring me four hearts of flame and four golem oil and I shall craft the torch of flawless flame.
rows.quest:3442:details:5: The golems and elementals in these lands should be your first target.
rows.quest:3442:completion:0: Well done, ⟦88⟧. We are almost ready.
rows.quest:3443:details:0: To hold the flawless flame, we will need a shaft and a casing. You must first find a suitable shaft.
rows.quest:3443:details:1: The Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers of the cauldron use weapons of enchanted thorium, an extremely sturdy alloy. If you bring me eight thorium plated daggers, I can break the alloy down and reforge a shaft.⟦89⟧
rows.quest:3443:completion:0: You're an exceptional laborer, ⟦91⟧. Have you ever considered a change of vocation? Perhaps a detective? Junk collector? Oh, I know, one of those silly gnomes that crawl across the beaches of ⟦E30⟧ with their metal detecting contraptions, looking for lost treasure. Yes, that would be an ideal position for you.
rows.quest:7728:obj:0: Find and return the ⟦E31⟧ and ⟦E32⟧ to ⟦E33⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7728:obj:1: The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The ⟦E31⟧ is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the ⟦E32⟧ is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.
rows.quest:7728:details:0: The following items have been stolen:
rows.quest:7728:details:3: BA reward is being offered to individuals who find and return these pilfered items.
rows.quest:7728:details:4: The Thorium Brotherhood is certain that these items were stolen by unscrupulous and jealous Dark Iron dwarves that inhabit the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7728:details:5: The spyglass in question was an excellent tool for the lookouts and the tuyere was an irreplaceable smithing tool.
rows.quest:7728:details:6: Should you find the missing items, return them to Scrange.
rows.quest:7728:progress:0: If you're here for the reward, you're gonna have to give me the stolen goods.
rows.quest:7728:completion:0: Fantastic work! Now for your reward.
rows.quest:7729:obj:0: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to ⟦E33⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ once you have accomplished this task.
rows.quest:7729:details:0: ⟦E33⟧ is looking for a few good men and women to help 'cull the competition' in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7729:details:1: If you are interested in this position, venture out into the ⟦E3⟧ and slaughter every ⟦E34⟧ and ⟦E35⟧ that you see.
rows.quest:7729:details:2: Return to ⟦E33⟧ when your clothes are bloody enough.
rows.quest:7729:details:3: You'll know when they're bloody enough so don't ask.
rows.quest:7729:progress:0: We're gonna need to weigh you with and without clothes to be sure.
rows.quest:7729:completion:0: 15.9 pounds! That may be a new record for blood and gut weight on apparel! Congratulations, ⟦92⟧!
rows.quest:7723:obj:0: ⟦E36⟧ wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
rows.quest:7723:obj:1: The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the ⟦E3⟧. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7723:details:0: Unfortunately, I can't dish out the beats like I used to, due to this here fat finger problem. Ye see, the climate out here combined with the lack o' air pressure makes me fingers expand. They're like gigantic ⟦E37⟧, they are...
rows.quest:7723:details:1: Ye're gonna have to carry out me orders of business and what have ye.
rows.quest:7723:details:2: First on me agenda: Poundin' the livin' daylights out o' the heavy war golems o' the Gorge. Get crackin'.
rows.quest:7723:completion:0: Ye're a good lad, ye are. I got ye a lil' present fer yer troubles.
rows.quest:7724:obj:0: ⟦E36⟧ wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the ⟦E3⟧. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7724:obj:1: Return to ⟦E36⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.
rows.quest:7724:details:0: Wouldn't ye know it, every time ol' Hansel wants to take a moment to relax and reflect upon his life, the powers that be give him another job.
rows.quest:7724:details:1: Me gots to think, come on! Ye know what I be saying? Come. On.
rows.quest:7724:details:2: So, these here greater lava spiders are causin' a ruckus o' some sort. Oilfist says they shoot fire out their... erm, yea well, anyway, such things upset the children.
rows.quest:7724:details:3: I guess we gots to kill 'em. Rather, ye gots to kill 'em.
rows.quest:7724:progress:0: Was he right? Does it come out their rumps?
rows.quest:7724:completion:1: I think I'm gettin' a cold. Damn this frigid climate!
rows.quest:7727:obj:1: You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7727:obj:2: Return to ⟦E36⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.
rows.quest:7727:details:0: Bunions, ⟦93⟧. Me bunions got bunions. How am I supposed to do any sort of killin' with me feet in such disarray? That's why ye're gonna help.
rows.quest:7727:details:1: Scrange and Burninate tasked me to kill these things so they can send some expeditionary teams down into the Slag Pit lava pools to do some explorin'. Supposedly some incendosaurs or some such nonsense down there causin' all kinds o' problems. Now move along an' don't come back 'til the incendosaur population be extinct.
rows.quest:7727:progress:0: <Hansel is busily rubbing his bunions.>⟦94⟧⟦95⟧Don't just stand there, grab some oil and a luffa and get to scrubbin' these bunions.⟦96⟧⟦97⟧Ye don't have a luffa? Well then! Perhaps it's time I sent you out to find a luffa?%⟦98⟧⟦99⟧Hey, where are ye goin'?

rows.quest:3377:details:0: Will you assist me, mortal? Hear my tale.
rows.quest:3377:progress:0: Allow me to finish my story.
rows.quest:3377:completion:0: I have accepted my fate here in this cage, but the prayer must be found.
rows.quest:3378:obj:0: Find the ⟦E38⟧ and take it to ⟦E39⟧ in ⟦E40⟧.⟦100⟧
rows.quest:3378:details:0: Will you assist me, mortal? Will you find the prayer to ⟦E41⟧?
rows.quest:3378:details:1: As I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet. One of these idol worshipping scoundrels must have it on their person.
rows.quest:3378:details:2: If you do recover my prayer, take it to ⟦E39⟧ in ⟦E40⟧. It matters little that my faith has been rekindled after the countless malevolent actions that I have taken against this world and its inhabitants, but my prayer must be heard. Absolution is the last thing I expect.
rows.quest:3378:progress:0: What brings you to the Temple of the Moon, ⟦101⟧?
rows.quest:3378:completion:0: ⟦E41⟧ smiles upon you this eve, ⟦102⟧. You have returned a lost soul to her. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.
rows.quest:3452:details:0: We need one final piece to form the torch.
rows.quest:3452:details:1: In the mountains to the northwest you will find a large encampment of Twilight's ⟦E44⟧. It is rumored that they carry symbols and idols that pay homage to their god. These symbols and idols could carry sufficient enchantment to form a magical casing. Bring me a single symbol of Ragnaros and I will try to extract the magic from the item to create the casing.
rows.quest:3452:progress:0: Without a suitable source of arcane energy, the torch of retribution cannot be completed.
rows.quest:3452:completion:0: The symbol radiates foul magic; perfectly suited for our task.
rows.quest:3453:details:0: Give me a moment to combine the pieces and apply the necessary enchantments.⟦104⟧
rows.quest:3453:progress:0: Do not interrupt the channeling process.
rows.quest:3453:completion:0: There is one final task that you must complete.
rows.quest:3454:details:0: The torch must now be bound to its owner. Pick up the torch, ⟦105⟧.
rows.quest:3454:completion:0: You grab the torch with both hands; waves of hatred and anger pulse through your being.
rows.quest:3462:details:0: Speak with my envoy, ⟦E47⟧. He will further instruct you as to the use of the ⟦E45⟧.
rows.quest:3462:completion:0: Are you prepared to make your strike?
rows.quest:3481:completion:0: The chest opens at your touch. How much cheese could possibly be in here? There is only one way to find out.
rows.quest:7701:obj:0: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the ⟦E3⟧, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named ⟦E48⟧.
rows.quest:7701:obj:1: Slay ⟦E48⟧ and take his head. Return the head to ⟦E49⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ for your reward.
rows.quest:7701:details:0: By order o' 'is eminence, ⟦E50⟧, the rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent an' newly hired commander o' the Dark Iron Slag Pit crew o' the Cauldron, ⟦E48⟧, is to be killed an' 'is head brung back as proof o' the deed.
rows.quest:7701:details:1: See Lookout Captan Lolo Longstriker fer the reward on this bounty.
rows.quest:7701:progress:0: Can't ya shee I'm bushy? What *hic* ish it ya be wantin? *hic*
rows.quest:7701:completion:0: I never thunk I'd be lookin' at thish ugly mug again!
rows.quest:7701:completion:1: He acshually looksh better without the resht o' him attached.
rows.quest:7704:details:0: Well, well, well... Isn't this a surprise. The Chambermaid had a gigantic ornate pillow and now it's yours. ⟦E52⟧ will definitely want to get her grubby little hands all over this item. Take it to her and see if she'll offer you any goodies for your trouble.
rows.quest:7704:progress:0: That is one huge pillow! Where'd you get it from?
rows.quest:7704:completion:0: This is better than even I could have thought possible! The Chambermaid's magical pillow is mine! You better believe you're going to get a nice reward for this accomplishment, ⟦107⟧!
rows.quest:7722:obj:0: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the ⟦E53⟧ that ⟦E48⟧ stole. Find those plans and return them to ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧.⟦108⟧
rows.quest:7722:details:0: When that bastard, Maltorius, left our clan, he left with something more valuable than a pristine arcane crystal: Our recipe for fiery flux! I'd bet anything that the recipe was part of the deal in his new promotion amongst the Dark Irons.
rows.quest:7722:details:1: I want you to get our secret plans back, ⟦109⟧. I'm sure they're somewhere near Maltorius, deep inside the Slag Pit.
rows.quest:7722:completion:0: I hope you kicked his teeth in too, ⟦110⟧. Ragnaros knows, he deserved it.
rows.quest:7722:completion:1: Now we can get down to business.
rows.quest:3372:obj:0: Find the ⟦E54⟧ being guarded by the Twilight's ⟦E44⟧ Idolaters in the northwest quadrant of the ⟦E3⟧ and bring it to the ⟦E55⟧ in the Slag Pit.⟦111⟧
rows.quest:3372:details:0: Release them, ⟦112⟧. Even after their bodies give out, the power of the Suntara forces them to complete their tasks.
rows.quest:3372:details:1: The altar of Suntara is the key. Go northwest; in the hills above the cave... Twilight's ⟦E44⟧ guard a relic. Retrieve it and place it on the altar of Suntara.
rows.quest:3372:completion:0: You place the mysterious artifact on the altar of Suntara.
rows.quest:3463:obj:0: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the ⟦E45⟧ inside each of the buildings. ⟦113⟧
rows.quest:3463:details:0: Listen well, ⟦114⟧. While the four towers can never be destroyed, you can use the torch of retribution to set them ablaze for a very long period of time: A fire that no element or force can subdue.
rows.quest:3463:details:1: While they are ablaze, no guard or sentry unit can inhabit the watch posts and thus, their first line of defense is nullified.
rows.quest:3463:details:2: You must enter each tower and use the ⟦E45⟧ within their fortifications. Beware the lookouts posted by the Dark Irons, ⟦115⟧.
rows.quest:3463:completion:0: It is glorious! Is it not glorious master?
